resources.string: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (CC-BY-4.0), about 670 MB. Transcribes 25 European languages, including Russian, Ukrainian and English, with punctuation, and detects the language on its own. It never translates. For a language outside those 25, Hanako uses an installed Whisper model instead.
Not enough free storage for the model.
On-device transcription: Parakeet doesn\'t support this language. Download a Whisper model in Hanako settings.
